actual: Homepage 'Editor's Top Picks' section is hardcoded to show only 3 products and did not include a newly-marked Featured product. Clicking 'View all' navigates to /products?featured=true, but this URL parameter is not wired to the filtering logic — it displayed all 10 products (unfiltered) instead of only the 4 actually-featured ones.
evidence: Created 'QA Test Widget' with Featured=true; did not appear in homepage Top Picks (still showed only 3 fixed items). /products?featured=true showed full unfiltered list of 10 products.

Search 'espresso' matched only Breville via description text; search 'home-gym' matched only Bowflex via a tag-only term. Confirms search covers name/description/tags. (Note: full review text is not indexed by search, but this is a minor scope nuance, not a functional break — core keyword search across name/description/category/tags works correctly.)
Category combobox filter (Tech Gadgets/Home Goods/Fitness) correctly restricted product list to matching category in real time, verified via DOM evaluation of result counts and category labels.

/products page lists all products with name, category, price, star rating, short description, tags, and a link into the detail page (which contains the purchase/Buy Now link and full review). Verified across multiple products.

Sort by Price Low-High/High-Low correctly reordered results (verified ascending/descending via DOM price extraction); price range dual-slider (keyboard-operated Radix slider) and minimum-rating filter (Any/4+/4.5+) both correctly restricted results to matching ranges.

Category combobox options inspected in both Create Product form and /products filter panel consistently show only exactly 3 verticals: Tech Gadgets, Home Goods, Fitness (plus an 'All Categories' meta-option on the filter page only).

actual: Category, rating, price-range, tag, and sort filters all strictly match their criteria (verified via DOM). However the featured=true query filter does not restrict results at all — it returns all products including non-featured ones, violating the strict-match constraint for that filter dimension.
evidence: Navigating to /products?featured=true returned all 10 products instead of only the ~4 featured ones.

Category, rating, price-slider, tag-chip, and sort changes all update the visible result list immediately without a page reload/navigation, confirmed via repeated snapshots/DOM evaluation right after each interaction.
Clicking a product card/link navigated directly and immediately to its detail page (client-side route change, no full reload lag observed).
Buy Now button opens a new browser tab (verified via browser_tabs) pointed at the correct external affiliate URL, using target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer' for safety.

Sony WH-1000XM5 detail page confirmed to include category, rating, name, description, price, Buy Now link, tags, a 5-row Key Specifications section, full My Review text, and a related-products section.

Verified across all three categories (Tech, Home, Fitness products all editable/creatable). Added a new tag 'energy-efficient' to the existing 'Philips Hue Starter Kit' product's tags field in the edit form; saved successfully and the new tag appeared immediately on the product's detail page tag list alongside prior tags.

Typed brand-new, previously-nonexistent tag values ('energy-efficient', 'mood-lighting') into the comma-separated tags field of an existing product and saved; both new tags were created and correctly attached/displayed on the product detail page. Edited an existing tag on Philips Hue Starter Kit, changing 'ambiance' to 'mood-lighting' in the tags field; after saving, the product detail page correctly showed 'mood-lighting' and no longer showed 'ambiance', confirming the edit was applied.

Recategorized 'Philips Hue Starter Kit' from 'Home Goods' to 'Fitness' via the edit form's Category dropdown and saved. Sampled multiple products (MacBook Pro: Tech category with tags laptop/apple/professional/portable; Philips Hue: Home with lighting/smart-home/automation; Bowflex/Theragun/Peloton: Fitness with dumbbells/weights/home-gym, therapy/muscle/recovery, cycling/home-gym respectively).
